ayahs.textArabic: يٰسۤ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā sīn.
ayahs.textEnglish: O THOU human being!

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْحَكِيْمِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-qur'ānil-ḥakīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Consider this Qur’an full of wisdom:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innaka laminal-mursalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: verily, thou art indeed one of God’s message-bearers,

ayahs.textArabic: عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍۗ
ayahs.textLatin: ‘Alā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: pursuing a straight way

ayahs.textArabic: تَنْزِيْلَ الْعَزِيْزِ الرَّحِيْمِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Tanzīlal-‘azīzir-raḥīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: by [virtue of] what is being bestowed from on high by the Almighty, the Dispenser of Grace,

ayahs.textArabic: لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ اُنْذِرَ اٰبَاۤؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غٰفِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Litunżira qaumam mā unżira ābā'uhum fahum gāfilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [bestowed upon thee] so that thou mayest warn people whose forefathers had not been warned, and who therefore are unaware [of the meaning of right and wrong].

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلٰٓى اَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Laqad ḥaqqal-qaulu ‘alā akṡarihim fahum lā yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Indeed, the word [of God’s condemnation] is bound to come true against most of them: for they will not believe.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِيْٓ اَعْنَاقِهِمْ اَغْلٰلًا فَهِيَ اِلَى الْاَذْقَانِ فَهُمْ مُّقْمَحُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā ja‘alnā fī a‘nāqihim aglālan fa hiya ilal-ażqāni fahum muqmaḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, around their necks We have put shack­les, reaching up to their chins, so that their heads are forced up;

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْۢ بَيْنِ اَيْدِيْهِمْ سَدًّا وَّمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَاَغْشَيْنٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ja‘alnā mim baini aidīhim saddaw wa min khalfihim saddan fa agsyaināhum fahum lā yubṣirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and We have set a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and We have enshrouded them in veils so that they cannot see:

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَوَاۤءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَاَنْذَرْتَهُمْ اَمْ لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa sawā'un ‘alaihim a'anżartahum am lam tunżirhum lā yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: thus, it is all one to them whether thou warnest them or dost not warn them: they will not believe.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّمَا تُنْذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكْرَ وَخَشِيَ الرَّحْمٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِۚ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَّاَجْرٍ كَرِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Innamā tunżiru manittaba‘aż-żikra  wa khasyiyar-raḥmāna bil-gaib(i), fa basysyirhu bimagfiratiw wa ajrin karīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thou canst [truly] warn only him who is willing to take the reminder to heart, and who stands in awe of the Most Gracious although He is beyond the reach of human perception: unto such, then, give the glad tiding of [God’s] forgiveness and of a most excellent reward!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِ الْمَوْتٰى وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوْا وَاٰثَارَهُمْۗ وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ اَحْصَيْنٰهُ فِيْٓ اِمَامٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā naḥnu nuḥyil-mautā wa naktubu mā qaddamū wa āṡārahum, wa kulla syai'in aḥṣaināhu fī imāmim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, We shall indeed bring the dead back to life; and We shall record whatever [deeds] they have sent ahead, and the traces [of good and evil] which they have left behind: for of all things do We take account in a record clear.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَّثَلًا اَصْحٰبَ الْقَرْيَةِۘ اِذْ جَاۤءَهَا الْمُرْسَلُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Waḍrib lahum maṡalan aṣḥābal-qaryah(ti), iż jā'ahal-mursalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND SET FORTH unto them a parable - [the story of how] the people of a township [behaved] when [Our] message-bearers came unto them.

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلَيْهِمُ اثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوْهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوْٓا اِنَّآ اِلَيْكُمْ مُّرْسَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż arsalnā ilaihimuṡnaini fa każżabūhumā fa ‘azzaznā biṡāliṡin faqālū innā ilaikum mursalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Lo! We sent unto them two [apostles], and. they gave the lie to both; and so We strengthened [the two] with a third; and thereupon they said: “Behold, we have been sent unto you [by God]!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا مَآ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَاۙ وَمَآ اَنْزَلَ الرَّحْمٰنُ مِنْ شَيْءٍۙ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا تَكْذِبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū mā antum illā basyarum miṡlunā, wa mā anzalar-raḥmānu min syai'(in), in antum illā takżibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [The others] answered: “You are nothing but mortal men like ourselves; moreover, the Most Gracious has never bestowed aught [of revelation] from on high. You do nothing but lie!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ اِنَّآ اِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū rabbunā ya‘lamu innā ilaikum lamursalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [the apostles]: “Our Sustainer knows that we have indeed been sent unto you;

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ اِلَّا الْبَلٰغُ الْمُبِيْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā ‘alainā illal-balāgul-mubīn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: but we are not bound to do more than clearly deliver the mes­sage [entrusted to us].”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْۚ  لَىِٕنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهُوْا لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُمْ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū innā taṭayyarnā bikum, la'il lam tantahū lanarjumannakum wa layamassannakum minnā ‘ażābun alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [the others]: “Truly, we augur evil from you! Indeed, if you desist not, we will surely stone you, and grievous suffering is bound to befall you at our hands!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا طَاۤىِٕرُكُمْ مَّعَكُمْۗ اَىِٕنْ ذُكِّرْتُمْۗ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū ṭā'irukum ma‘akum, a'in żukkirtum, bal antum qaumum musrifūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [The apostles] replied: “Your destiny, good or evil, is [bound up] with yourselves! [Does it seem evil to you] if you are told to take [the truth] to heart? Nay, but you are people who have wasted their own selves!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَاۤءَ مِنْ اَقْصَا الْمَدِيْنَةِ رَجُلٌ يَّسْعٰى قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُوا الْمُرْسَلِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa jā'a min aqṣal-madīnati rajuluy yas‘ā qāla yā qaumittabi‘ul-mursalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: At that, a man came running from the farthest end of the city, [and] exclaimed: “O my people! Follow these message-bearers!

ayahs.textArabic: اتَّبِعُوْا مَنْ لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ اَجْرًا وَّهُمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ  ۔
ayahs.textLatin: Ittabi‘ū mal lā yas'alukum ajraw wa hum muhtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Follow those who ask no reward of you, and themselves are rightly guided!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا لِيَ لَآ اَعْبُدُ الَّذِيْ فَطَرَنِيْ وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā liya lā a‘budul-lażī faṭaranī wa ilaihi turja‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “[As for me,] why should I not worship Him who has brought me into being, and to whom you all will be brought back?

ayahs.textArabic: ءَاَتَّخِذُ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اٰلِهَةً اِنْ يُّرِدْنِ الرَّحْمٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّيْ شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا يُنْقِذُوْنِۚ
ayahs.textLatin: A'attakhiżu min dūnihī ālihatan iy yuridnir-raḥmānu biḍurril lā tugni ‘annī syafā‘atuhum syai'aw wa lā yunqiżūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Should I take to worship­ping [other] deities beside Him? [But then,] if the Most Gracious should will that harm befall me, their intercession could not in the least avail me, nor could they save me:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنِّيْٓ اِذًا لَّفِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Innī iżal lafī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: and so, behold, I would have indeed, most obviously, lost myself in error!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنِّيْٓ اٰمَنْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُوْنِۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Innī  āmantu birabbikum fasma‘ūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: “Verily, [O my people,] in the Sustainer of you all have I come to believe: listen, then, to me!”

ayahs.textArabic: قِيْلَ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ ۗقَالَ يٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِيْ يَعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qīladkhulil-jannah(ta), qāla yā laita qaumī ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] he was told, “[Thou shalt] enter paradise!” - [whereupon] he exclaimed: “Would that my people knew

ayahs.textArabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِيْ رَبِّيْ وَجَعَلَنِيْ مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Bimā gafaralī rabbī wa ja‘alanī minal-mukramīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: how my Sustainer has forgiven me [the sins of my past], and has placed me among the honoured ones!”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَمَآ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلٰى قَوْمِهٖ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ مِنْ جُنْدٍ مِّنَ السَّمَاۤءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنْزِلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā anzalnā ‘alā qaumihī mim ba‘dihī min jundim minas-samā'i wa mā kunnā munzilīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And after that, no host out of heaven did We send down against his people, nor did We need to send down any:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ كَانَتْ اِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمْ خٰمِدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: In kānat illā ṣaiḥataw wāḥidatan fa'iżā hum khāmidūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: nothing was [needed] but one single blast [of Our punishment] - and lo! they became as still and silent as ashes.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى الْعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ḥasratan ‘alal-‘ibād(i), mā ya'tīhim mir rasūlin illā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: OH, THE REGRETS that [most] human beings will have to bear! Never has an apostle come to them without their deriding him!

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ اَنَّهُمْ اِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam yarau kam ahlaknā qablahum minal-qurūni annahum ilaihim lā yarji‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Are they not aware of how many a generation We have destroyed before their time, [and] that those [that have perished] will never return to them,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيْعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa in kullul lammā jamī‘ul ladainā muḥḍarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [that] all of them, all together, will [in the end] before Us be arraigned?

ayahs.textArabic: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الْاَرْضُ الْمَيْتَةُ ۖاَحْيَيْنٰهَا وَاَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa āyatul lahumul-arḍul-maitah(tu), aḥyaināhā wa akhrajnā minhā ḥabban faminhu ya'kulūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [yet,] they have a sign [of Our power to create and to resurrect] in the lifeless earth which We make alive, and out of which We bring forth grain, whereof they may eat;

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيْهَا جَنّٰتٍ مِّنْ نَّخِيْلٍ وَّاَعْنَابٍ وَّفَجَّرْنَا فِيْهَا مِنَ الْعُيُوْنِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ja‘alnā fīhā jannātim min nakhīliw wa a‘nābiw wa fajjarnā fīhā minal-‘uyūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [how] We make gardens of date-palms and vines [grow] thereon, and cause springs to gush [forth] within it,

ayahs.textArabic: لِيَأْكُلُوْا مِنْ ثَمَرِهٖۙ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ اَيْدِيْهِمْ ۗ اَفَلَا يَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Liya'kulū min ṡamarihī wa mā ‘amilathu aidīhim, afalā yasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: so that they may eat of the fruit thereof, though it was not their hands that made it. Will they not, then, be grateful?

ayahs.textArabic: سُبْحٰنَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ الْاَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنْۢبِتُ الْاَرْضُ وَمِنْ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Subḥānal-lażī khalaqal-azwāja kullahā mimmā tumbitul-arḍu wa min anfusihim wa mimmā lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Limitless in His glory is He who has created opposites in whatever the earth produces, and in men’s own selves, and in that of which [as yet] they have no knowledge.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الَّيْلُ ۖنَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهَارَ فَاِذَا هُمْ مُّظْلِمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa āyatul lahumul-lailu naslakhu minhun-nahāra fa'iżā hum muẓlimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [of Our sway over all that exists] they have a sign in the night: We withdraw from it the [light of] day - and lo! they are in darkness.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِيْ لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۗذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيْرُ الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِيْمِۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wasy-syamsu tajrī limustaqarril lahā, żālika taqdīrul-‘azīzil-‘alīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [they have a sign in] the sun: it runs in an orbit of its own [and] that is laid down by the will of the Almighty, the All-Knowing;

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰى عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُوْنِ الْقَدِيْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-qamara qaddarnāhu manāzila ḥattā ‘āda kal-‘urjūnil-qadīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [in] the moon, for which We have determined phases [which it must traverse] till it becomes like an old date-stalk, dried-up and curved:

ayahs.textArabic: لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنْۢبَغِيْ لَهَآ اَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا الَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ ۗوَكُلٌّ فِيْ فَلَكٍ يَّسْبَحُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lasy-syamsu yambagī lahā an tudrikal-qamara wa lal-lailu sābiqun-nahār(i), wa kullun fī falakiy yasbaḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and] neither may the sun overtake the moon, nor can the night usurp the time of day, since all of them float through space [in accordance with Our laws].

ayahs.textArabic: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمْ اَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُوْنِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa āyatul lahum annā ḥamalnā żurriyyatahum fil-fulkil-masyḥūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [it ought to be] a sign for them that We bear their offspring [over the seas] in laden ships,

ayahs.textArabic: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ مِّثْلِهٖ مَا يَرْكَبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa khalaqnā lahum mim miṡlihī mā yarkabūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [that] We create for them things of a similar kind, on which they may embark [in their travels];

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيْخَ لَهُمْ وَلَاهُمْ يُنْقَذُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa in nasya' nugriqhum falā ṣarīkha lahum wa lā hum yunqażūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [that,] if such be Our will, We may cause them to drown, with none to respond to their cry for help: and [then] they cannot be saved,

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا اِلٰى حِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Illā raḥmatam minnā wa matā‘an ilā ḥīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: unless it be by an act of mercy from Us and a grant of life for a [further span of] time.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوْا مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā qīla lahumuttaqū mā baina aidīkum wa mā khalfakum la‘allakum turḥamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [yet,] when they are told, “Beware of [God’s insight into] all that lies open before you and all that is hidden from you, so that you might be graced with His mercy,” [most men choose to remain deaf;]

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا تَأْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ اٰيَةٍ مِّنْ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ اِلَّا كَانُوْا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā ta'tīhim min āyatim min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ‘anhā mu‘riḍīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and no message of their Sustainer s messages ever reaches them without their turning away from it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمْ اَنْفِقُوْا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ ۙقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لِلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اَنُطْعِمُ مَنْ لَّوْ يَشَاۤءُ اللّٰهُ اَطْعَمَهٗٓ  ۖاِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā qīla lahum anfiqū mimmā razaqakumullāh(u), qālal-lażīna kafarū lil-lażīna āmanū anuṭ‘imu mal lau yasyā'ullāhu aṭ‘amah(ū), in antum illā fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thus, when they are told, “Spend on others out of what God has provided for you as sus­tenance,” those who are bent on denying the truth say unto those who believe, “Shall we feed anyone whom, if [your] God had so willed, He could have fed [Himself]? Clearly, you are but lost in error!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaqūlūna matā hāżal-wa‘du in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they add, “When is this promise [of resurrection] to be fulfilled? [Answer this] if you are men of truth!”

ayahs.textArabic: مَا يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā yanẓurūna illā ṣaiḥataw wāḥidatan ta'khużuhum wa hum yakhiṣṣimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And they are unaware that] nothing awaits them beyond a single blast [of God’s punishment], which will overtake them while they are still arguing - [against resurrection]:

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ تَوْصِيَةً وَّلَآ اِلٰٓى اَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Falā yastaṭī‘ūna tauṣiyataw wa lā ilā ahlihim yarji‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and so [sudden will be their end that] no testament will they be able to make, - nor to their own people will they return!

ayahs.textArabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصُّوْرِ فَاِذَا هُمْ مِّنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمْ يَنْسِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nufikha fiṣ-ṣūri fa'iżā hum minal-ajdāṡi ilā rabbihim yansilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [then] the trumpet [of resurrection] will be blown - and lo! out of their graves towards their Sustainer will they all rush forth!

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا يٰوَيْلَنَا مَنْۢ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜهٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū yā wailanā mam ba‘aṡanā mim marqadinā…hāżā mā wa‘adar-raḥmānu wa ṣadaqal-mursalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They will say: “Oh, woe unto us! Who has roused us from our sleep [of death]?” [Whereupon they will be told:] “This is what the Most Gracious has promised! And His message-bearers spoke the truth!”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ كَانَتْ اِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمْ جَمِيْعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: In kānat illā ṣaiḥataw wāḥidatan fa'iżā hum jamī‘ul ladainā muḥḍarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nothing will there have been but one single blast - and lo! before Us will all of them be arraigned [and be told]:

ayahs.textArabic: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا تُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fal-yauma lā tuẓlamu nafsun syai'aw wa lā tujzauna illā mā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “Today, then, no human being shall be wronged in the least, nor shalt you be requited for aught but what you were doing [on earth].

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ اَصْحٰبَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِيْ شُغُلٍ فٰكِهُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna aṣḥābal-jannatil-yauma fī syugulin fākihūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “Behold, those who are destined for paradise shall today have joy in whatever they do:

ayahs.textArabic: هُمْ وَاَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِيْ ظِلٰلٍ عَلَى الْاَرَاۤىِٕكِ مُتَّكِـُٔوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Hum wa azwājuhum fī ẓilālin ‘alal-arā'iki muttaki'ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: in happiness will they and their spouses on couches recline;

ayahs.textArabic: لَهُمْ فِيْهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَّلَهُمْ مَّا يَدَّعُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Lahum fīhā fākihatuw wa lahum mā yadda‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [only] delight will there be for them, and theirs shall be all that they could ask for:

ayahs.textArabic: سَلٰمٌۗ قَوْلًا مِّنْ رَّبٍّ رَّحِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Salāmun qaulam mir rabbir raḥīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: peace and fulfillment through the word of a Sustainer who dispenses all grace.

ayahs.textArabic: وَامْتَازُوا الْيَوْمَ اَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wamtāzul-yauma  ayyuhal-mujrimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “But stand aside today, O you who were lost in sin!

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ اَلَمْ اَعْهَدْ اِلَيْكُمْ يٰبَنِيْٓ اٰدَمَ اَنْ لَّا تَعْبُدُوا الشَّيْطٰنَۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam a‘had ilaikum yā banī ādama allā ta‘budusy-syaiṭān(a), innahū lakum ‘aduwwum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Did I not enjoin on you, O you children of Adam, that you should not worship Satan – since, verily, he is your open foe

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَنِ اعْبُدُوْنِيْ ۗهٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ani‘budūnī, hāżā ṣirāṭum mustaqīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and that you should worship Me [alone]? This would have been a straight way!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اَضَلَّ مِنْكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيْرًا ۗاَفَلَمْ تَكُوْنُوْا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad aḍalla minkum jibillan kaṡīrā(n), afalam takūnū ta‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [as for Satan -] he had already led astray a great many of you: could you not, then, use your reason?

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذِهٖ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِيْ كُنْتُمْ تُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżihī jahannamul-latī kuntum tū‘adūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “This, then, is the hell of which you were warned again and again:

ayahs.textArabic: اِصْلَوْهَا الْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Iṣlauhal-yauma bimā kuntum takfurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: endure it today as an outcome of your persistent denial of the truth!”

ayahs.textArabic: اَلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلٰٓى اَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ اَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Al-yauma nakhtimu ‘alā afwāhihim wa tukallimunā aidīhim wa tasyhadu arjuluhum bimā kānū yaksibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: On that Day We shall set a seal on their mouths but their hands will speak unto Us, and their feet will bear witness to whatever they have earned [in life].

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ نَشَاۤءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلٰٓى اَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَاَنّٰى يُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau nasyā'u laṭamasnā ‘alā a‘yunihim fastabaquṣ-ṣirāṭa fa annā yubṣirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: NOW HAD IT BEEN Our will [that men should not be able to discern between right and wrong], We could surely have deprived them of their sight, so that they would stray forever from the [right] way: for how could they have had insight [into what is true]?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ نَشَاۤءُ لَمَسَخْنٰهُمْ عَلٰى مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوْا مُضِيًّا وَّلَا يَرْجِعُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau nasyā'u lamasakhnāhum ‘alā makānatihim famastaṭā‘ū muḍiyyaw wa lā yarji‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And had it been Our will [that they should not be free to choose between right and wrong], We could surely have given them a different nature [and created them as beings rooted] in their places, so that they would not be able to move forward, and could not turn back.]

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَنْ نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى الْخَلْقِۗ اَفَلَا يَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa man nu‘ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq(i), afalā ya‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But [let them always remember that] if We lengthen a human being’s days, We also cause him to decline in his powers [when he grows old]: will they not, then, use their reason?

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا عَلَّمْنٰهُ الشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنْۢبَغِيْ لَهٗ ۗاِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَّقُرْاٰنٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā ‘allamnāhusy-syi‘ra wa mā yambagī lah(ū), in huwa illā żikruw wa qur'ānum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [thus it is:] We have not imparted to this [Prophet the gift of] poetry, nor would [poetry] have suited this [message]: it is but a reminder and a [divine] discourse, clear in itself and clearly showing the truth,

ayahs.textArabic: لِّيُنْذِرَ مَنْ كَانَ حَيًّا وَّيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyunżira man kāna ḥayyaw wa yaḥiqqal-qaulu ‘alal-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: to the end that it may warn everyone who is alive [of heart], and that the word [of God] may bear witness against all who deny the truth.

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ اَيْدِيْنَآ اَنْعَامًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مٰلِكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yarau annā khalaqnā lahum mimmā ‘amilat aidīnā an‘āman fahum lahā mālikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Are they, then, not aware that it is for them that We have created, among all the things which Our hands have wrought, the domestic animals of which they are [now] masters? –

ayahs.textArabic: وَذَلَّلْنٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوْبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa żallalnāhā lahum fa minhā rakūbuhum wa minhā ya'kulūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and that We have subjected them to men’s will, so that some of them they may use for riding and of some they may eat,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَهُمْ فِيْهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۗ اَفَلَا يَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lahum fīhā manāfi‘u wa masyārib(u), afalā yasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and may have [yet other] benefits from them, and [milk] to drink? Will they not, then, be grateful? (

ayahs.textArabic: وَاتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wattakhażū min dūnillāhi ālihatal la‘allahum yunṣarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But [nay,] they take to worshipping deities other than God, [hoping] to be succoured [by them, and not knowing that]

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ نَصْرَهُمْۙ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُّحْضَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā yastaṭī‘ūna naṣrahum, wa hum lahum jundum muḥḍarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: they are unable to succour their devotees, even though to them they may [appear to] be hosts drawn up [for succour].

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘاِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوْنَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falā yaḥzunka qauluhum, innā na‘lamu mā yusirrūna wa mā yu‘linūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: However, be not grieved by the sayings of those [who deny the truth]: verily, We know all that they keep secret as well as all that they bring into the open.

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْاِنْسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقْنٰهُ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيْمٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yaral-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min nuṭfatin fa'iżā huwa khaṣīmum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: IS MAN, then, not aware that it is We who create him out of a [mere] drop of sperm - whereupon, lo! he shows himself endowed with the power to think and to argue?

ayahs.textArabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَّنَسِيَ خَلْقَهٗۗ قَالَ مَنْ يُّحْيِ الْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ḍaraba lanā maṡalaw wa nasiya khalqah(ū), qāla may yuḥyil-‘iẓāma wa hiya ramīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [now] he [argues about Us, and] thinks of Us in terms of comparison, and is oblivious of how he himself was created! [And so] he says, “Who could give life to bones that have crumbled to dust?”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ يُحْيِيْهَا الَّذِيْٓ اَنْشَاَهَآ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۗوَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيْمٌ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul yuḥyīhal-lażī ansya'ahā awwala marrah(tin), wa huwa bikulli khalqin ‘alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “He who brought them into being in the first instance will give them life [once again], seeing that He has full knowledge of every act of creation:

ayahs.textArabic: ۨالَّذِيْ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الْاَخْضَرِ نَارًاۙ فَاِذَآ اَنْتُمْ مِّنْهُ تُوْقِدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażī ja‘ala lakum minasy-syajaril-akhḍari nārā(n), fa'iżā antum minhu tūqidūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: He who produces for you fire out of the green tree, so that, lo! you kindle [your fires] therewith.”

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰٓى اَنْ يَّخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ ۗبَلٰى وَهُوَ الْخَلّٰقُ الْعَلِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Awa laisal-lażī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa biqādirin ‘alā ay yakhluqa miṡlahum, balā wa huwal-khallāqul-‘alīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Is, then, He who has created the heavens and the earth not able to create [anew] the like of those [who have died]? Yea, indeed - for He alone is the all-knowing Crea­tor:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّمَآ اَمْرُهٗٓ اِذَآ اَرَادَ شَيْـًٔاۖ اَنْ يَّقُوْلَ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Innamā amruhū iżā arāda syai'an ay yaqūla lahū kun fa yakūn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: His Being alone is such that when He wills a thing to be, He but says unto it, “Be” — and it is.

ayahs.textArabic: فَسُبْحٰنَ الَّذِيْ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَكُوْتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَّاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa subḥānal-lażī biyadihī malakūtu kulli syai'iw wa ilaihi turja‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Limitless, then, in His glory is He in whose hand rests the mighty dominion over all things; and unto Him you all will be brought back!
